title: Module 1: Hello Java
story_text:
# ☕ The Coffee Cup

Java runs on the JVM (Java Virtual Machine). Everything must be in a **class**.

`System.out.println("Hello");`
quiz_data: [{"question": "Main method signature?", "options": ["void main()", "public static void main(String[] args)", "int main()", "def main"], "answer": 1}]

title: Module 2: Variables
story_text:
# 📦 Types

- `int`: Integers
- `double`: Decimals
- `boolean`: true/false
- `String`: Text (Capital S!)
hints: Booleans are not strings. Remove quotes.

title: Module 3: Strings Comparison
story_text:
# 🎭 The Twin Trap

`==` compares object references (memory address).
`.equals()` compares content.

Always use `.equals()` for Strings!

title: Module 4: Arrays
story_text:
# 📋 Lists

`int[] arr = {1, 2, 3};`

Use `.length` to get size (no parentheses!).

title: Module 5: Loops
story_text:
# 🔁 Cycles

`for (int i=0; i<5; i++)`

Same as C++.
hints: Use semicolons ; inside for loop, not commas.

title: Module 6: Methods
story_text:
# 🧩 Methods

Inside a class, functions are called methods.

`public static int add(int a, int b)`

`static` means it belongs to the class, not an object.
hints: Specify return type 'int' before method name.

title: Module 7: Classes
story_text:
# 🏭 Factory

`Dog d = new Dog();`

In Java, almost everything is an object.
hints: d2 is null. You cannot access .name on null.

title: Module 8: ArrayList
story_text:
# 📦 Box That Grows

`ArrayList<String> list = new ArrayList<>();`

- `add()`
- `get(index)`
- `size()`

title: Module 9: HashMap
Module 10: Private & Public
story_text:
# 🔒 Security

- `public`: Everyone can access
- `private`: Only this class
- `protected`: Subclasses too
hints: Change 'private' to 'public' or add a getter.

title: Module 11: Inheritance
story_text:
# 🧬 DNA

`class Cat extends Animal`

Java only supports **single inheritance**.

title: Module 12: Interfaces
story_text:
# 📜 The Contract

`interface Drawable { void draw(); }`

If you implement it, you MUST define the methods.
hints: Interface methods are public. Your implementation must be 'public' too.

title: Module 13: Try-Catch
story_text:
# 🛡️ Shield

Catch exceptions before they crash your app.

`try { ... } catch (Exception e) { ... }`
hints: Wrap valid logical code in try-catch block.

title: Module 14: Constructor
story_text:
# 🏗️ Builder

Same name as class. No return type.
hints: Constructors have no return type, not even void.

title: Module 15: Static
story_text:
# ⚡ Shared Power

`static` variables are shared by ALL objects of that class.
quiz_data: [{"question": "Static method can access instance vars?", "options": ["Yes", "No", "Sometimes", "Only public"], "answer": 1}]
